transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been bothering you or what brings you here today?
I guess… since I stopped working, I just can’t seem to slow down. I’m up and moving all day, going from one little job to the next, like I still got a crew waiting on me or something.
Have you been needing less sleep lately, or feeling like you don’t need as much rest as you used to?
I don’t think so. I mean, I still get tired. Sleep’s about the same, far as I can tell.
Have you noticed your mood being unusually high, or found yourself taking on a lot more projects or activities than usual?
Not really high mood, no. It’s more… since I stopped working, I’m just always doing something. Little jobs around the house, one after another, like I still got people depending on me to keep moving.
Have you noticed that you need less sleep lately, or that you feel rested even if you haven’t slept much?
No… I wouldn’t say that. If I don’t sleep much, I feel it. I still need my rest.
Have you felt unusually good, like you were on top of the world, or maybe more confident or powerful than usual?
No, not really. I don’t feel like that… just regular, I guess.
Have you had any period where your mood was noticeably more irritable or elevated for several days in a row, even if it didn’t last a full week?
I don’t think so. I mean, I can get annoyed like anyone, but not for days where it felt… different or anything.
Have you had any days recently where you felt down, depressed, or hopeless for most of the day, nearly every day?
Not really… I mean, I have off days, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been down or hopeless most of the day nearly every day.

Have you had any period lasting at least four days in a row where you felt a noticeable change in your mood—like being unusually upbeat, wired, or irritable—along with a big increase in your activity level or energy?
No… I don’t think I’ve had anything like that for four days straight. Nothing that stood out to me, anyway.

Have you had any distinct period of time—maybe a few days or longer—where your mood was clearly different from usual, like being unusually upbeat, irritable, or wired, along with a big increase in your activity level or energy?
No, not that I’ve noticed. I don’t think I’ve had a stretch like that where I was really different from usual or had a big jump in energy.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks where you felt down, depressed, or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day?
I don’t think so. I’ve had low days here and there, but not two weeks like that, not most of the day every day.

Have you had any shorter periods—maybe just a couple of days—where your mood was clearly different from usual, like being unusually upbeat, wired, or irritable, along with a noticeable increase in your activity level or energy?
No… not really. I mean, I can have a day where I’m more on edge or restless, but I don’t think I’ve had a couple days where my mood was clearly different like that.

Have you had any periods, even just a day or two, where your mood was clearly different from usual—like being unusually upbeat, wired, or irritable—along with a noticeable increase in your energy or activity level?
No, I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had normal ups and downs, but not where I’d say my mood and energy were clearly different like that.

Have you had any time, even just for a day, where your mood was clearly not normal for you—like unusually high, excited, or irritable—along with a real jump in your energy or activity level that stood out compared to how you usually feel?
No, I don’t think I’ve had anything like that. Not where it stood out as unusual for me.

Have you had any time, even just a single day, where your mood or behavior was clearly different from your usual self—like feeling unusually excited, agitated, or full of energy in a way that stood out?
I don’t think so. Nothing that really stood out to me like that, no.
Have you had any moments, even just part of a day, where your mood or behavior was clearly not normal for you—like feeling unusually excited, agitated, or full of energy in a way that stood out?
Not really. I mean, I get frustrated like anyone, but nothing where I’d say I was acting different or had some big burst of energy.
Looking back, have you had a period lasting at least four days in a row where you felt more energetic, restless, or irritable than usual—even if it didn’t feel like a full manic episode?
No, I don’t think so. I can’t recall anything lasting several days like that.
